findings.spec_ref: Spec section 2 (Structure): 'either a Regenerate ghost button (when succeeded) or a kebab icon button (otherwise) on the right'; Button component compatibility section: 'For the header bar Regenerate button: <Button styleType="text" onClick={handleRegenerate}><Icon name="refresh-cw" /> Regenerate</Button>'
findings.description: The header bar renders a 'Buy credits' button instead of the spec-required 'Regenerate' button when status is 'succeeded' AND totalCreditsRemaining is 0. The spec defines exactly two states for the header right: 'Regenerate' (when succeeded) and kebab (otherwise). The spec's Button component compatibility section prescribes a single unconditional Regenerate button with no zero-credits conditional. The credit balance guard ('When credits are zero and a generate action would be shown, show the existing buy-credits pattern') applies to the zero states (Empty, Failed) where the primary action IS the generate button -- not to the header bar which the spec treats separately. The implementation introduces a third header state (Buy credits admin link or Buy credits modal button) that has no spec basis.
findings.actual: When succeeded AND totalCreditsRemaining == 0: header shows either <Button styleType="text" type="internalLink" link="/hire/settings/ai-billing">Buy credits</Button> (admin) or <Button styleType="text" onClick={handleBuyCredits}>Buy credits</Button> (non-admin)
findings.expected: When succeeded: header always shows <Button styleType="text" onClick={handleGenerate}><Icon name="refresh-cw" /> Regenerate</Button> regardless of credit balance

verified_requirements.detail: renderBody() checks summaryExists && status === 'succeeded' first. Correct.

verified_requirements.req: State machine row 2: status is pending/in_progress/extracted -> renderGenerating()
verified_requirements.detail: renderBody() second check: summaryExists && (status === 'pending' || status === 'in_progress' || status === 'extracted'). All three values included, correct order.

verified_requirements.req: State machine row 3: status === 'textract_processing' -> renderProcessing()
verified_requirements.detail: renderBody() third check: summaryExists && status === 'textract_processing'. Correct.

verified_requirements.req: State machine row 4: status === 'failed' -> renderFailed()
verified_requirements.detail: renderBody() fourth check: summaryExists && status === 'failed'. Correct.

verified_requirements.req: State machine row 5: no summary AND hasResume truthy -> renderEmpty()
verified_requirements.detail: renderBody() fifth check: !summaryExists && jobApplication.hasResume. Correct.

verified_requirements.req: State machine row 6: no summary AND hasResume falsy -> renderNoResume()
verified_requirements.detail: Final return renderNoResume() is correct fallback for the no-summary+no-resume case.

verified_requirements.req: State machine evaluation order: first match wins, succeeded before pending/in_progress/extracted before textract_processing before failed before no-summary+has-resume before no-summary+no-resume
verified_requirements.detail: The six if-blocks in renderBody() follow the exact ordering from spec table.
